customers.evidence: our purpose is to develop the affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress

employees.evidence: We develop leaders and collaborate as one team to deliver industry-leading performance.

dei.evidence: We have an inclusive work environment that values the uniqueness and diversity of individual talents, experiences and ideas.

environment.evidence: We believe the future of energy will be lower carbon, and we intend to be a leader in that future.

community.evidence: to achieve solutions and breakthroughs that benefit our shareholders and society

shareholders.evidence: We aim to deliver industry-leading results.

integrity.evidence: We earn trust and respect by acting with integrity and operating with the highest ethical standards.

safety.evidence: We aim to lead our industry in health, safety and environmental performance.

innovation.evidence: demands pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice, with five named values (partnership, performance, people and environment, trust and integrity, diversity and inclusion) framing the page. Commitments mix absolute wording ('is our highest priority') with hedged phrasing ('we aim', 'we intend'). Energy purpose and lower-carbon future lead, with employees and safety addressed early in the value headings.
